title: Archive C verification batching and failed complete speed gates
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Source-pinned C rational batching, integer sparse loops and canonical witness formatting against frozen PR5864. All six complete frozen-qualifier scientific receipts agree. The descriptive 6.47% wall / 6.21% CPU median reductions fail the requested 15% target and both declared repeat-spread noise gates. No qualified positive speedup, kappa, construction or selected-frontier claim. Rational construction stops at the losing cost of restoring the required independent literal Fraction oracle.

## Task and overlap

Task replay-runtime, refined to donor-requested C opportunities 1, 2 and 4. Canonical main de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a; official 163-file PR5864 export at 3f15c943e4ad6479f03e674c80fff1269a16ccfe is an immutable declared input. Extends [PR5848](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5848), [PR5852](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5852), [PR5853](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5853) and [PR5864](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5864); distinct from the failed thin score-dispatch [PR5875](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5875). Opportunity 3, matrix/GF(2), is a separate workload and contributes no percentage here.

## Validation

`python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/c-verification-feasibility` freshly runs original custody/finite/native checks and new integer/rational finite checks in normal and optimized modes. Added coverage includes 8,192-bit integers, signed cancellation, aliases, complete ordered bytes, 178 rational comparisons, arithmetic drift and fallback rejection. All 120 original fixtures and full 25,984-event / 799-coordinate ideal, weights, signed witnesses, hashes and reverse comparisons remain in the six timed qualifier runs. Candidate includes its added cold compile/load and validation bill; compiler children count in CPU.

The four unchanged custody checks are separate from BOTH timed arms, matching PR5864 benchmark scope; no portable replay-driver total is claimed. Fresh readonly Git-free replay of all five registered commands, metadata/source pins and 125 committed package bytes/modes pass. Every sample and draft is retained; no timing rerolls. Full optimized/readonly performance qualification was not pursued after the failed gates. Linux CPython 3.12.3 / GCC 13.3, existing compiler/headers, no installs or committed binaries. Hosted correctness CI remains separate from local performance evidence.

The corrected head `4b6d9c0d630b7809e43651eadcb4921ea5dbde56` retains the initial hosted failure and explicitly admits only the two reviewed CPython patch/source pairs. All live arithmetic guards remain; unknown source bytes reject even after the code cache is populated. Local normal/optimized and readonly compatibility replays pass; hosted replay is tracked separately. No measured C kernel or timing sample changed.

One further rejection-only diagnostic observes all 246 original integer Engine call boundaries with unchanged arithmetic. Its 4.855752 wall / 4.853204 CPU seconds are below the fixed baseline 15% thresholds even at zero replacement cost. Host variation and the narrower observed-cost boundary are explicit; no broader state-owner construction or universal obstruction is claimed.

## Credit

Ali Romman and all retained P104/native/compiler/precision predecessor authors; previous source-bound table/entry/compact/slot/C-bookkeeping contributions; PR5875 negative screen. Inherited Ali Romman PR5761 three-file routing-test repair is unchanged and credited. Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex implementation and user-requested GPT-6-astra xhigh static review; one parent numerical runner. No independent human or proof-kernel acceptance. Apache-2.0 notices retained.

## Open next questions

[Report and exact limits](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4b6d9c0d630b7809e43651eadcb4921ea5dbde56/research/c-verification-feasibility/README.md), [structured questions](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4b6d9c0d630b7809e43651eadcb4921ea5dbde56/research/c-verification-feasibility/TASK.json). A different arithmetic ownership boundary needs a new bounded complete-cost screen preserving the required oracle. No further construction or timings are justified for these frozen nominations this round.
